transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been really struggling to pay attention to details and keep making careless mistakes at work. This has been going on for about 10 months now, so I wanted to get some help.
Have you struggled with these focus and attention issues since childhood, or is this a completely new problem that started 10 months ago?
I've actually struggled with these kinds of focus issues since I was a kid, definitely before I was 12. However, they have become much more noticeable and problematic for me over the last 10 months.
Along with these focus issues, have you often struggled with feeling restless, fidgeting, or having difficulty sitting still, both now and when you were growing up?

No, I've never really struggled with physical restlessness or fidgeting, and I can sit still without much trouble. My issues are much more about my mind constantly wandering and having a really hard time keeping my concentration on my work.
Over the past 10 months, have you also been feeling consistently down, sad, or lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?
No, I haven't really felt that way. My mood has been pretty normal, and I still enjoy doing the things I like to do.
Over the last several months, have you been struggling with persistent, excessive worry or anxiety about everyday things that you find difficult to control?
No, I wouldn't say I struggle with that. I don't really experience persistent worry or anxiety in my daily life.
